correctness.rationale: For all labelled C_n, n>=3, the circular 3-state 00/01/10 transfer has characteristic polynomial t^3-t-1 and trace P_n, the Perrin count. A return to state 01 over d steps is a_d, giving exact two-point counts a_d*a_(n-d); centering and diagonalizing the circulant covariance yields the stated complete Fourier eigenvalues. A 2,3 cyclic gap interchange forces every constant-on-sample linear statistic to have all equal coefficients for n=5 and n>=7; different maximal set cardinalities remove that last kernel for n>=8. The five small exceptional ranks and n=6 nonconstant k=1,5 nulls follow from exact small configurations. The renewal root expansion has rate rho=alpha^(-3/2), giving O(n*rho^n) error uniformly in grid frequency; its density simplifies to p*A*B/Q(cos(theta)), and the strictly convex Q puts maximum at the unique interior negative cosine and minimum at theta=0, yielding the sharp ratio 43.42455574592406... Independent exact rational moment/covariance ranks for n=3..12 match the recurrence and stated classification; these finite computations are not the proof for all n.
